exclusions: Lower Largo car parks and public toilets are not transferred to Lundin Links.
Golf-club and hotel parking are customer facilities, not published as general public parking.
boundaryRule: Only visitor places physically inside Lundin Links's strict study area, or an explicitly related cross-boundary route that genuinely serves it, are published.
scoreRationale: Lundin Links is a strong coastal stop: nationally important standing stones, shoreline, visitor golf, two credible coffee-and-cake options and three verified routes including a live Treasure Trail. The lack of a verified general public car park and public toilet keeps it below the top tier.

scoreReanalysis.rationale: Score was independently reconciled after all categories, named-provider checks and boundary exclusions; no final score remains at the provisional exact-58 trigger.
